claims.title: Learn hidden cycle responses and return globally optimal controls

quoted_fields.interface: Known n>=1 binary controls x in F2^n and chosen-setting scalar observations of f(x)=c+sum_i theta_i*(-1)^(a_i dot x), with distinct nonzero canonical masks a_i. A has those masks as rows. Promise: some edge-labeled undirected multigraph G, allowing loops, parallel edges and disconnected components, satisfies im A=ker B_G; equivalently the column matroid of A^T is COGRAPHIC. The graph, masks, coefficients and an external sparsity bound are not inputs. Requested configurations must actually be realized. Exact finite-bit rational observations or the stated independent centered subgaussian-noise model; accuracy/confidence and total observation/input encoding costs are explicit.
quoted_fields.failure: Complete visible source derivations and implementation/experiments are received as a source-reported construction. Original proof PDF, code, results.json and substantive audit attachments remain unacquired under the P3 transfer hold; no new Capital rerun or audit overlay. Graph identities certify the ACQUIRED representation, not an unrestricted physical black box or absent unseen interactions. Wrong graphic/cut-space orientation contains Max-Cut; regularity alone is insufficient. Noise guarantee assumes realized requested controls and fresh independent observations; k-bit actuation flips attenuate a parity by (1-2p)^k and can require exponentially many observations. Arbitrary pinned controls/edit budgets/feasibility restrictions are outside the guarantee. No partition function, mixing-time result, quantum-state preparation, apparatus, historical priority or practical advantage is established. Earlier Maltsev work is preserved unchanged and uniform acquisition there remains unresolved.
